attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elske knelt beside Bertram, the blood dark against the dirt.","severity":"major","reason":"places Elske at the death scene; the briefing says only that Bertram died on the hunt, and does not put Elske among the hunters"},{"span":"Rook nudged her hand, a low whine vibrating in his chest.","severity":"major","reason":"Rook came home alone per briefing, so he cannot be at the body"},{"span":"She looked toward the woods where Dunmore had slipped away.","severity":"minor","reason":"adds a specific detail (woods) about the escape and implies Elske witnessed it"},{"span":"worn leather of his jacket","severity":"minor","reason":"added detail about Bertram's clothing"}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The scene puts Elske and Rook at the site of Bertram's death, contradicting the briefing that Rook came home alone and placing Elske at a past event.
